terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms describe how you may use ForkThis.

sections.heading: What this is
body: ForkThis suggests recipes and restaurant orders and lets you track what you eat. Nutrition figures are estimates.

sections.heading: Your use
body: Use the app to explore and plan your meals. Don't rely on it for decisions about your health, allergies or diet.

sections.heading: Changes
body: Features, data and these terms may change from time to time.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: The short version: we keep what you give us to run the app, and you can export or delete it.

sections.heading: What is stored
body: Your profile, saved items and logged meals and water are stored against your account so they follow you across devices.

sections.heading: Who can see it
body: Only you, through your account. You choose whether analytics and personalised recommendations are on.

sections.heading: Removing it
body: You can export your data or delete your account from Help & support.
Deleting your account removes your data permanently.

health.title: Health disclaimer
health.intro: Please read this before acting on any number the app shows you.

sections.heading: General information only
body: ForkThis gives general nutrition information. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

sections.heading: Estimates, not measurements
body: Calorie and BMI figures are estimates from formulas, not clinical measurements.
BMI does not account for muscle, frame or age, and calorie targets vary from person to person.

sections.heading: Allergies
body: Allergen flags are based on ingredient names and can miss things. Always check packaging and ask the restaurant.

sections.heading: Talk to a professional
body: Talk to a qualified clinician before changing your diet, especially around surgery or a medical condition.
